_readme: Adobe Commerce pack knowledge. The two lists below are a SEED (see _stamp): they were written from stable platform knowledge and must be re-verified per engagement against developer.adobe.com/commerce (GraphQL and REST references) and the Page Builder documentation for the exact target version and edition.

target_api_endpoint_families covers two surfaces: GraphQL (storefront) entries are written as 'graphql query:' / 'graphql mutation:' plus the operation name, REST entries as their /V1 path. B2B operations only exist on Adobe Commerce with the B2B module installed - a fit estimation must check the edition first.

target_content_component_types lists Page Builder content types and the classic CMS/widget building blocks. Page Builder content is stored as HTML with data-content-type markup, so in a headless frontend each of these types needs its own renderer.
target_api_endpoint_families: graphql query: products (search, filter, sort, aggregations)
graphql query: route / urlResolver, cmsPage, cmsBlocks
graphql query: storeConfig, countries, currency, availableStores
graphql query: customer (orders, addresses, wishlists, reviews)
graphql query: B2B - requisitionLists, negotiableQuote / negotiableQuotes, company (structure, roles, users, credit)
graphql mutation: cart lifecycle - createEmptyCart, mergeCarts, addProductsToCart, updateCartItems, removeItemFromCart
graphql mutation: checkout steps - setGuestEmailOnCart, setShippingAddressesOnCart, setBillingAddressOnCart, setShippingMethodsOnCart, setPaymentMethodOnCart, applyCouponToCart
graphql mutation: createCustomerV2, generateCustomerToken, requestPasswordResetEmail, updateCustomerV2, addProductsToWishlist
graphql mutation: B2B - createRequisitionList, addProductsToRequisitionList, createCompany, createCompanyUser, requestNegotiableQuote, sendNegotiableQuoteForReview, placeNegotiableQuoteOrder
/async/V1/... and /async/bulk/V1/... (asynchronous and bulk variants of the REST routes)
target_content_component_types: Page Builder layout: Row
Page Builder layout: Column Group / Column
Page Builder layout: Tabs / Tab Item
Page Builder element: Text
Page Builder element: Heading
Page Builder element: Buttons / Button Item
Page Builder element: Divider
Page Builder element: HTML Code
Page Builder element: Block (CMS block reference)
Page Builder element: Dynamic Block (customer-segment driven, Adobe Commerce only)
Page Builder element: Products (product list by condition or SKU)
Page Builder media: Image
Page Builder media: Video
Page Builder media: Banner
Page Builder media: Slider / Slide
Page Builder media: Map
Page Builder add-on: Adobe Stock image
CMS Page (with Page Builder or raw HTML content)
CMS Block (embedded via widget, layout XML or Page Builder Block element)
Widget: CMS Static Block, Catalog Products List, Recently Viewed/Compared Products, Catalog Category Link, Catalog Product Link, CMS Page Link, Orders and Returns
Custom Page Builder content type (configuration XML + admin form + Luma renderer + headless renderer)

_stamp.verify_first: target 2.4.x version and edition (Open Source vs Adobe Commerce vs Cloud), GraphQL coverage of the required B2B operations, Page Builder renderer coverage in the chosen frontend, Page Builder vs Edge Delivery Services as the target content model
